product.title: Hiking in the Rockies - Group hike tour near Denver

description.text: In Denver, enjoy the beauty of a hike in the Rockies without the worry of getting lost or picking an unsuitable trail during this full-day excursion. Plus, save your strength for the hike thanks to round-trip transportation and learn about the wildflowers and wildlife from your guide, something that would be harder to do alone. Stops include Rocky Mountain Trailhead, Scenic Mountain Overlook. Transportation and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Denver's foothills scenery, red-rock amphitheater views, and Rocky Mountain day-trip landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Denver who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating transport, trailheads, or mountain logistics on their own.
